newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two firms in Misawa group to merge in April.
newsitem.headline: Two firms in Misawa group to merge in April.

text.p: Misawa Ceramic Chemical Co Ltd, a specialist manufacturer of ceramic housing materials, said on Friday that it would be absorbed by Misawa Ceramics Corp on April 1, 1997.

The merger of the two medium-sized companies, which are both in the Misawa Homes Co Ltd group, was aimed at improving efficiency in terms of capital investment and production, the company said in a statement.

Shares in Misawa Ceramic Chemical will be delisted from the second section of Tokyo Stock Exchange following the action. The firm, which produces prefabricated ceramic outer walls for houses, is currently listed on the second section of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.

Misawa Ceramics will issue 12 million new shares. Each 0.75 Misawa Ceramic Chemical share will be exchanged for one Misawa Ceramics share. At the time of the merger, Misawa Ceramic Chemical shareholders will be given five yen per share.

Following the merger, Misawa Ceramics is expected to post a parent current profit of 569 million yen in the next business year to March 1998, and 859 million yen in the year after that, the statement said.
